mechanism: Both drugs exhibit anticholinergic properties; famotidine's H2-blocking activity combined with oxybutynin's potent anticholinergic effects may produce additive anticholinergic adverse effects.
action: Monitor for excessive anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, cognitive impairment); consider alternative H2-blocker with minimal anticholinergic activity if clinically feasible.
